headlines.title: Robert J. Mylod, Jr. Elected a Director of Graham Holdings Company
headlines.summary: ARLINGTON, Va., November 05, 2026--Graham Holdings Company (NYSE: GHC) announced today that Robert J. Mylod, Jr. has been elected to the Board of Directors.

headlines.title: Booking Holdings Jumped 14% in a Week. Its Forward P/E Shows What the Rebound Assumes
headlines.summary: Key TakeawaysBooking Holdings (BKNG:NASDAQ) stock jumped 14% in the past week, most of it after a Q3 report that beat the company’s own guidance. Its forward P/E was 13.

headlines.title: Lola Launches Lola VIP Drops, Giving Members Access to Hard-to-Get Tables and Tickets in New York
headlines.summary: NEW YORK, November 05, 2026--Getting a table at New York’s hottest restaurants or tickets to its biggest shows can mean stiff competition. Today, Lola, the AI assistant for experiences backed by Booking Holdings (NASDAQ: BKNG), launched Lola VIP Drops to help members access last-minute reservations at sought-after restaurants and tickets to sporting events, concerts, theater, and festivals, beginning in New York City with additional cities coming soon.

headlines.title: Booking (BKNG) Stock Jumps As Q3 Results Spotlight Margin Strength
headlines.summary: Booking Holdings lit up the screen today. The stock jumped 9.8% to US$170.98, a sharp move for a company of this size, after posting Q3 2026 results that outpaced its own guidance on room nights, gross bookings and adjusted revenue. Short term traders see a price spike. Longer term investors see something different: a travel platform reporting a trailing net profit margin of 25.5% and a trailing P/E of 17.8x that sits below both peer and broader industry averages.

description: Booking Holdings Inc., together with its subsidiaries, provides online and traditional travel and restaurant reservations and related services in the United States, the Netherlands, the United Kingdom, and internationally. The company operates Booking.com, which offers online accommodation reservations; and Priceline, which provides discount travel reservations services, as well as online accommodation, flight, rental car reservation services, vacation packages, cruises, activity, and affiliate programs. It also operates Agoda that offers online accommodation reservation, flight, ground transportation, and attractions. In addition, the company operates KAYAK, an online meta-search service that allows consumers to search and compare travel itineraries and prices; and OpenTable for booking online restaurant reservations, as well as reservation management services to restaurants. Further, it offers travel-related insurance products, payment facilitation, and restaurant management services to consumers, travel service providers, and restaurants; and advertising services. The company was formerly known as The Priceline Group Inc. and changed its name to Booking Holdings Inc. in February 2018. Booking Holdings Inc. was founded in 1997 and is headquartered in Norwalk, Connecticut.
